title: On the Trail With Spain’s Prime Minister, as He Tries to Pull Out a Win
summary_full: Pedro Sánchez, Europe’s most prominent left-wing leader, seems set to lose power in an election next week. Our reporter trailed his last-ditch effort to turn his campaign around.
